results.query: Raging ya bullying ka case kidr ho skta? And what can I do?
gold_facts: Hazing or Raging is strictly prohibited
creates a substantial risk of causing mental or physical harm or humiliation
Discipline Committee is to act as an inquiry committee to investigate reported cases of violation of discipline
results.answer:
Raging ya bullying ka case student discipline committee mein ho sakta hai, especially agar is mein hazing, disorderly conduct, ya mental or physical harm ka koi risk ho. Agar aap kisi student ke saath bullying ya hazing ki baat karein, to aap uski report karein aur evidence (jaise proof ya statement) collect karein. Aap ko report karein jaise kisi teacher ya staff ke saath, jo uss case ko dekh sakta hai. Aapki report ko student discipline committee tak pahuncha dene ke baad, unhone case ko investigate karke punishment suggest kar sakta hai. Aap ko aapki point of view bhi present karni chahiye.  

Answer based on: Student_Discipline_Regulations

results.query: Teacher ki complaint kese ho skti? Or kaha ho skti
gold_facts: All faculty members, administrative staff, support staff and students will be expected to monitor the observance of this code of conduct and report any such disregard or violations to relevant University authorities for taking appropriate action/remedial measures
results.answer:
Teacher ki complaint student ke against ho sakti hai aur uski complaint Student Discipline Committee ya Departmental Committee ke through kari jati hai. Agar teacher ko student ke against koi indiscipline ki baat milti hai to woh us case ko Student Discipline Committee ya President Student Discipline Committee ke pase refer kar sakti hai. Agar case serious hai to Student Discipline Committee ko case investigate karna padta hai. Teacher normally complainant bana ke evidence present karega.  

Yeh information Student_Discipline_Regulations document se milti hai.
